main_body: conical thatched-roof hut with mud-brick wall and doorway
top_band: yellow-brown layered thatched roof slope from row 2 to row 58 (curving down on the sides of the doorway; above the doorway arch it runs rows 2-50)
evidence: Reading down a column just left of the doorway: rows 2-58 show the large visible top/front slope of the conical thatched roof with stepped horizontal bands and a lighter bottom fringe at rows 57-58; rows 59-61 show a dark brown eave shadow cast onto the mud-brick wall; rows 61-78 show the vertical wall face and stone plinth. The doorway in the center (rows 50-77) has an inset arch and recessed dark interior with visible inner frame.

style.evidence: The thatched roof uses 6+ warm yellow-brown shades with per-bundle vertical grain and cylinder lighting across the cone. Outlines are dark brown material tones. The mud-brick wall has subtle brick coursework, lighter/darker plaster patches, and a detailed stone foundation, matching the Beodeul building craft closely.
